name: Block Visibility Days
description: Adds day-of-week/date conditions to block visibility settings.
project_description:
Block Visibility Days module is used to display block according to the days condition. The module provides the Visibility Days tab in the configuration section of Block from where you can select days on which you want to display the block.

 CONTENTS OF THIS FILE 

 * Introduction

 * Installation

 * Configuration

 INTRODUCTION 

Block Visibility Days module Enhances the visibility settings by adding a condition of days.

 INSTALLATION 

Simply enable the module by drush command or by admin panel extend tab.

 CONFIGURATION 

To add days to a block, simply visit that block's configuration page visibility settings at

Administration > Structure > Blocks
